info.name: Waai Media - Portfolio API
info.description:
Postman Collection (v2.1) for the Waai Media Portfolio module (admin dashboard + public website). Every request matches a route implemented in this repository.

### Safe testing sequence
1. **Authentication** (folder 0): select `Waai Media - Local Environment` (`docs/Waai_Media_Local.postman_environment.json`), fill the admin/editor email and password (secret values live in the environment, never in this collection) and run both logins.
2. **Categories** and 3. **Clients** (folder 1): stores every category/subcategory id and two existing clients (`client_id`, `client_id_2`).
4. **Create** (folder 2): a draft and one published example per category.
5. **Update and upload media** (folder 3), 6. **Publish** (folder 4).
7. **Verify the public API** (folder 5), 8. **filters and pagination** (folder 6; admin filters).
9. **Unpublish and verify exclusion** (folder 7). Folder 8 holds negative/authorization tests.
10. **Deletion** (folder 9): disposable records only; the DELETE requests are skipped unless `confirm_destructive` = `yes`.

Use a local or test server (`base_url` variable, default http://127.0.0.1:8000). Do not run destructive requests against production.

### Roles
Admin and Editor: list, show, create, update, publish/unpublish. Delete (Portfolio and Client) is Admin/Super Admin only; Editor receives 403.

### Client, cover and uniqueness
Every item belongs to one existing client (`client_id`). A client can hold only one item per subcategory, and one per main category for Web Design; drafts reserve the slot too (422, plus a database unique index). A subcategory is required whenever the main category has subcategories, also for drafts. Every item has a dedicated `cover_image` (required to publish, optional for drafts) that is separate from work images and from the client logo. On a repeated run, delete the earlier items or use other clients, otherwise the create requests answer 422 (slot already used).

### Multipart rules
Use `form-data`. File fields are type **File** (`cover_image`, `media[N][image]`, `featured_image`, client `logo`); URLs are type **Text**. To update with files use `POST` with `_method=PATCH` (PHP does not parse multipart on real PATCH/PUT). Images: PNG/JPG only, max 10 MB. Videos are URLs only. There is no limit on the number of images per item; if a request would exceed server upload limits, add more images through several update requests (existing images are always preserved).

### Draft vs publish
`status` omitted (create) = draft. A draft needs one title, a client, a main category and its subcategory. `status=published` (or POST `/publish`) records `published_at` (same lifecycle as Events; unpublish clears it) and requires both Arabic and English titles, the cover and the category content.

### Public browsing
Experience A: `GET /portfolio` (cards; filters category_id, subcategory_id, client_id) -> `GET /portfolio/{id}`. Experience B: `GET /portfolio/clients?category_id=` (unique client cards) -> `GET /portfolio/clients/{id}?category_id=` (subcategory tabs) -> `GET /portfolio/{id}`. Homepage: `GET /portfolio?per_page=3`. Categories: `GET /categories?type=portfolio` with optional `level=parent`, `parent_id=` or `include_children=1`.

### R2 checks
After each upload confirm the UUID object exists under `portfolio/images/`; after replace/remove/delete confirm the old object is gone.

exec: // Safety guard: destructive requests only run against disposable test records and only when explicitly enabled.

if (pm.collectionVariables.get('confirm_destructive') !== 'yes') { console.warn('Skipped. Set the collection variable confirm_destructive to yes to run destructive requests (disposable test data on a local/test server only).'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
else if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('test_portfolio_id')) { console.warn('Skipped. test_portfolio_id is not set: run the create steps of this folder first.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
